operations.description: Updates the specified metadata for the specified version. This method will fail with `FAILED_PRECONDITION` in the event of an invalid state transition. The supported [state](../sites.versions#versionstatus) transitions for a version are from `CREATED` to `FINALIZED`. Use [`DeleteVersion`](delete) to set the status of a version to `DELETED`.
